items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Me, Paul Bobran, Kitto, and Lance Trotter on the drums.

ctx.x: Did they make more money on working the door than they get a cash job?

The Papa Salter's band was so far down one time, I worked with them. I worked with them for a while. Yeah. During the time when he had Adam Kitto, Paul Bobran was here. Paul Bobran was on the drums. The thing was bad. Yeah. Paul was in there. I was in rhythm section. Me, Paul Bobran, Kitto, and Lance Trotter on the drums. Mm-hmm.
Did you make more money going out of town than playing in New Orleans?
